Question:
A 4.0 kg block slides down a frictionless incline that makes an angle of 30° with the horizontal. Use g = 10 m/s². What is the magnitude of the normal force exerted by the incline on the block?

A. 20 N
B. 35 N
C. 40 N
D. 46 N

Question:
A 2.5 kg crate slides down a frictionless ramp whose horizontal length is 4.0 m and whose height is 3.0 m. Use g = 10 m/s². What is the magnitude of the normal force exerted by the ramp on the crate?

A. 19 N
B. 25 N
C. 15 N
D. 20 N

Question:
A 2.0 kg block slides down a frictionless plane. The surface of the plane makes an angle of 25° with the vertical. Use g = 10 m/s². What is the magnitude of the normal force exerted by the plane on the block?

A. 8.5 N
B. 18 N
C. 47 N
D. 20 N

Question:
A 3.0 kg cart of constant mass moves along a straight track with velocity v(t) = (4.0 m/s²)t + 1.0 m/s, where t is in seconds. What is the magnitude of the net force on the cart at t = 2.0 s?

A. 13.5 N
B. 27 N
C. 12 N
D. 4.0 N

Question:
A 1.5 kg block of constant mass moves along a line with velocity v(t) = (2.0 m/s⁴)t³ − (3.0 m/s²)t, where t is in seconds. What is the magnitude of the net force on the block at t = 2.0 s?

A. 3.0 N
B. 15 N
C. 7.5 N
D. 31.5 N

Question:
A 2.0 kg object of constant mass moves along the x-axis with position x(t) = (0.50 m/s⁴)t⁴ − (2.0 m/s)t, where t is in seconds. What is the magnitude of the net force on the object at t = 1.5 s?

A. 13.5 N
B. 9.5 N
C. 27 N
D. 9.0 N
